description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for cart management in an e-commerce application. It exposes endpoints to create, retrieve, update, and delete cart items, managing interactions via HTTP requests.

classes.name: CartController
classes.description: REST API controller for cart operations, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting cart items.

methods.name: getOrCreateActiveCart
methods.description: Retrieves an existing active cart for a given customer or creates a new one.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Fetches a cart along with its items by cart ID.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart, increments if the product already exists.

methods.name: setItemQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of a specific product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart based on product ID.
